notes: All checked lines hold: Sunday 2 September 1962 and Mel's Drive-In, the white T-bird ('A white '56. I saw you on Third Street'), Terry the Tiger, Carol the 'cousin', the police car's back axle, the Wolfman 'is everywhere', the message read on air and the Paradise Road race (Wikipedia plot); Vic's knuckle sandwich, the double Chubby Chuck, Old Harper and the ID 'flood', and Steve's 'You just can't stay seventeen forever.' (Wikiquote). Story year 1962 on the sign line, drink note and bay number; '1973' only sits in the title block. Still (Terry and Steve at Mel's) does not repeat the poster.

vibe.verdict: Mel's carhop menu with the Wolfman, the T-bird, Toad's Chubby Chuck and Carol's line to Falfa reads like the real night on the strip.
missing: Milner's yellow deuce coupe and the car graveyard (John and Carol)
Curt and the Pharaohs at the arcade
